summary: Ron Brabander, 58, of Woodland Park, killed while snow biking near the summit of Cottonwood Pass west of Buena Vista; snowmobilers near the summit heard the slide just after noon and went to investigate, finding a snow bike ski tip in the debris; a search-and-rescue team that happened to be in the area for avalanche training responded
location: Cottonwood Pass summit area, west of Buena Vista
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office + search-and-rescue team (in-area avalanche training)
notes: Run 61 CAIC 2015-16 thin-year chunk. CAIC season table: 1 caught, 1 partially buried-critical, 1 killed. AP via Accident Data Center (modified 2016-02-06).
